ModMetaData.name: Witcher Base
ModMetaData.author: Tristan
ModMetaData.description:
The foundation mod for a modular Witcher content suite. Adds the Witcher trials to RimWorld Biotech.
Research the trials to transform colonists into witchers: - Trial of Grasses: a brutal initiation. Most who attempt it do not survive. Survivors become witcher initiates with hardened bodies and night sight. - Trial of Dreams: a follow-up trial for initiates. Survivors become fully trained witchers with sharper minds and steadier nerves. - Trial of Mountains: the final trial. Send a witcher to slay a great beast and become a master witcher. - Additional Mutagens: a perilous upgrade for existing witchers that pushes their gifts to the extreme.
Grasses, Dreams, and Mutagens are performed from the Health tab. Mountains is begun from a witcher's health tab once researched.
Requires Biotech.
